blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Honoring the life and legacy of one of the country’s distinguished statesmen, the Ilocos Sur government marked the late President Elpidio R. Quirino’s 136th birth anniversary through a commemorative gathering in Vigan City on Monday. Born in Vigan on November 16, 1890, Quirino served as the country’s sixth president from 1948 to 1953. Before assuming the presidency, he held various public service positions, including legislator, Cabinet member, and vice president. His administration played a significant role in the country’s postwar recovery, focusing on economic reconstruction, restoring peace and order, and strengthening government institutions.
